title: Di Klinik Kesihatan
canDo: Register at a government clinic and take a queue number
Describe symptoms in more detail than A1
Understand basic instructions from clinic staff
Ask about fees and medicine collection
lifeBenefit: Handle a full clinic visit independently, from registration to collecting medicine.

vocab.exampleEn: Please register at the counter first.

vocab.example: Ambil nombor giliran kat mesin tu.
vocab.exampleEn: Take a queue number from that machine.
Do you have an old patient card?

vocab.example: Anak saya sakit perut sejak semalam.
vocab.exampleEn: My child has had a stomach ache since yesterday.
He/she has diarrhoea and is vomiting.
Since when has this pain been there?

vocab.example: Rawatan ni percuma untuk warga asing?
vocab.exampleEn: Is this treatment free for foreigners?

vocab.en: collect medicine at the pharmacy counter
vocab.example: Lepas jumpa doktor, ambil ubat kat kaunter farmasi.
vocab.exampleEn: After seeing the doctor, collect medicine at the pharmacy counter.

vocab.example: Doktor bagi surat rehat dua hari.
vocab.exampleEn: The doctor gave a two-day medical leave note.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'Please take a queue number and register at the counter.'
practiceExercises.answer: Sila ambil nombor giliran dan daftar kat kaunter.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'I've had a stomach ache and diarrhoea since this morning.'
practiceExercises.answer: Saya sakit perut dan cirit-birit sejak pagi tadi.

practiceExercises.prompt: Match: where do you collect medicine, and what does the doctor give if you need rest?

scenario.setting: A full visit: registration, seeing the doctor, and collecting medicine at a klinik kesihatan

script.en: Do you have an old patient card?

script.ms: Tak ada, ini kali pertama saya datang.
script.en: No, this is my first time coming here.

script.ms: Okay, isi borang ni. Sakit apa?
script.en: Okay, fill in this form. What's wrong?

script.ms: Sakit kepala dan demam, sejak dua hari.
script.en: Headache and fever, for two days.

script.ms: Baik, saya bagi ubat. Ambil kat kaunter farmasi.
script.en: Alright, I'll give you medicine. Collect it at the pharmacy counter.

scenario.aiPrompt: You are alternating between a nurse (registration/intake) and a doctor (diagnosis) at a Malaysian government health clinic. Ask about patient history, symptoms and their duration, and any related symptoms, then direct the patient to collect medicine at the pharmacy. Use clear, simple, colloquial KL Malay and stay patient and professional.

speakingPrompts.instructions: Shadow the full clinic-visit dialogue across all three roles, keeping a calm, clear tone.
Play the patient through registration and diagnosis with the AI nurse/doctor personas, describing two symptoms and their duration.

questions.prompt: Translate: 'I have a headache and a stomach ache.'
questions.answer: Saya sakit kepala dan sakit perut.

questions.prompt: Where do you collect prescribed medicine?
Translate: 'This is my first time here, I don't have an old patient card.'
questions.answer: Ini kali pertama saya datang, saya tak ada kad pesakit lama.
